patterns.note: Hero section features a large, full-bleed illustrative background with a prominent product UI card embedded below the main CTA, providing an immediate product preview.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, readable sans-serif body text.
A vibrant green is consistently used for primary call-to-action buttons and interactive elements, contrasting with a cool blue hero and neutral white/grey backgrounds.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background to maintain visibility and save space.
Key feature sections are introduced with a large, bold heading and a concise subheading, often followed by a grid of supporting details or visual examples.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero section uses a large, illustrative background image with a subtle gradient overlay, featuring a central text block and an embedded, layered product UI card that appears to float above the background.

The main navigation bar implements a sticky behavior, where it reduces its vertical padding and changes its background from transparent to solid white as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Content is structured using a combination of full-width sections and card-based layouts, with a consistent use of subtle rounded corners for interactive elements and content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a clear hierarchy, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons, input fields, and content cards, maintaining a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between main sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, especially in the hero.

standout: The site stands out by integrating a detailed, interactive-looking product UI card directly within the hero section, offering an immediate and tangible preview of the platform's capabilities rather than just abstract marketing copy. This, combined with the prominent 'NEW' banner, creates a sense of active development and innovation.
